representative_posts.author: huntthesnark.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And I am by no means an AI hater, but at least where I am, the way it's being used feels, in some ways, just...wrong. AI writes docs and there's so much that you can only get through it all with AI. It's like informational kudzu.

representative_posts.author: hackkitten.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Every time it's 'AI coding agents are very useful, but...'. Right up there with 'There's a massive AI demand, but...'. Feels like that 'but' is becoming rather load-bearing at this point.

representative_posts.author: numlock.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We’re not that heavily into AI written code thankfully, but as one of the people who spend a significant amount of time reading PRs, I can see why they left. The amount of generated code even from a single AI user makes it feel like I’m just tidying up after others with little time to code myself

representative_posts.author: tiptoe39.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Because of the material that I edit, I see a TON of AI-generated writing. My job is generally to edit it so it feels a little more genuine without adding so much red ink that the client complains about overediting. It’s a weird tightrope to walk.

representative_posts.author: bpal.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Our creative process hasn't changed much over 20+ years. We're still just looking at the world around us, allowing ourselves to be deliciously horrified by it, and then welcoming others to share that feeling with us. Why would anyone buy art from someone who outsources this experience to AI?

representative_posts.author: hazzyarts.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: ArtCraft now has a substance painter and substance designer knockoff. Fuck adobe, fuck vibe coding, but like fuck adobe more? Either way i thought about it and will keep paying adobe for sp and sd just so i feel right saying i dont use any AI in my workflow without needing to caveat anything.

representative_posts.author: ixgunnhildr.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: i feel like way way to often anti "ai" discourse takes the form of just unquestioningly repeating silicon valley pr spin but with a /negative tone indicator and does more harm than good as a result

representative_posts.author: davidclewis.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: sgordonthe87.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: philyred.bsky.social

representative_posts.text: Leeds fan and I expected a red. Genuinely shocked it wasn't carded even after VAR.

representative_posts.author: renowallabout.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: tonypdickinson.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: amattyg.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: hwilks.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: How was that not a red card and didn’t even give a yellow # COYS

representative_posts.author: philcosta.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah it should've been a red card. Just said the contact was accidental!

representative_posts.author: joseybackupnorth.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: peterberkes.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: millertime1976.bsky.social
